# dsh-web-search-plus
English | 中文

Provider **priority** for DeepSeek Harness web search: put Tavily and the native DeepSeek
provider i

n whatever order you want, fall through to the next one when the first fails, and
rotate several Tav
ily keys to spread the free daily quota.
## Install
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Refresh the browser once, then open **Plugins → 网页搜索++** and press **Take over**.
Pinned tag instead of the npm release:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

**Requires dsh 0.1.0 or newer.** The plugin talks to the `ctx.web` seam and the `webServer`
prefix r
outes; on an older host it registers nothing and says why in the log.
## Why this exists
The `ctx.web` seam selects **exactly one** provider by id:
| State | What the seam does |

| A provider id is configured | Uses only that one; failure is failure |
| No id, exactly one provid

er usable | Uses it |
| No id, several usable | Throws `WEB_PROVIDER_AMBIGUOUS` |

There is no priority chain and no fallback. This plugin registers **one** provider
(`web-search-plus
`) and runs the chain inside it:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

The DeepSeek node calls the **official provider instance** rather than re-implementing it, so
its ke

y, account token, endpoint and usage limits keep coming from **Settings → Web search** —
nothing dri
fts when upstream changes.
## What you get
- **Ordered fallback** — move the two providers up and down; the first one that answers wins, the ne

xt runs when the previous fails or (optionally) returns nothing
- **Multi-key rotation** — up to 20
Tavily key slots. A rate-limited (`429`) or quota-exhausted key cools down and the chain moves to th
e next one automatically; each slot shows its live state (`ready` / `invalid` / `cooling down`) and

the one in use is marked
- **Per-key usage** — ask Tavily for each slot's current plan usage in one

click, so you can see which key is nearly spent before a search fails
- **Hand back cleanly** — *Han
d back to official search* writes `deepseek-official` back to the `web` row and the chain stops bein
g consulted. The *Try one search* probe follows the same state, so it never claims the chain ran whi

le the seam points somewhere else
- **Secrets stay in the credential domain** — keys are written thr
ough `ctx.credentials`, never to the settings file, never into a snapshot response, never into a log
. Saved keys can be revealed on request with the eye button, which asks the host for exactly one slo

t over a loopback-only, no-store route
- **No surprises on the page** — an action locks only its own
control group; the 1 s cooldown ticker does not repaint the cards; the note line keeps its height s

o cards do not shift when a message appears
- **Bilingual UI** — follows the interface language (`zh

o not shift when a message appears
- **Bilingual UI** — follows the interface language (`zh` / `en`)
## Manage it from the Plugins page

The settings card lives in **Plugins → 网页搜索++**, and falls back to the kernel
**Built-in plugins** p
age when the experience platform is absent. Four cards:
| Card | What it does |

| Priority | Reorder the chain; one switch decides whether the chain is consulted at all |
| Tavily

keys | Key slots, per-slot state, reveal / save / clear / remove, add slot, reset cooldowns |
| Tavi

ly options | Endpoint, search depth, result cap, timeout, rate-limit cooldown, answer summary |
| St
atus | Takeover state, chain availability, run one probe, fetch per-key usage |
## How the chain actually behaves
| Situation | Result |

| First node answers | Its result is returned; later nodes are not called |
| First node throws | Re

ason is recorded, next node runs |
| Node is not registered | Recorded as *not registered*, next nod

e runs |
| Caller cancels | Propagates immediately — cancellation does **not** fall through |
| Ever
y node fails | `WEB_SEARCH_CHAIN_EXHAUSTED`, one line per node with its reason |

With `fallbackOnEmpty` on, an **empty** result counts as a failure and the chain continues; off,
an
empty result is a legitimate answer.
## Security
- Management routes accept **loopback only**, and additionally require a loopback `Host`, a same-ori
gin `Origin` when present, a non-`cross-site` `Sec-Fetch-Site`, and `application/json` on writes — s
o a page in your browser cannot read your keys even though these routes sit outside the host's sessi

on auth
- Key values are write-only in every listing: `GET` never contains a secret
- The reveal rou
te returns **one** slot per request, carries `no-store`, refuses refs that are not configured, and i

s never called automatically
- The publish step runs `tools/scan-sensitive.mjs`, which blocks API-ke
y shapes, private keys, connection strings, personal paths and session ids
## Configuration

Every option lives in the plugin row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and is editable from
the p

y option lives in the plugin row of your profile's `cordis.patch.yml` and is editable from
the page:
| Key | Default | Meaning |

| `priority` | `[tavily, deepseek-official]` | Chain order |
| `tavilyKeyRefs` | `[TAVILY_API_KEY]`

| Credential refs, in rotation order |
| `tavilyBaseURL` | `https://api.tavily.com` | Endpoint (`/se

arch` and `/usage` are appended) |
| `tavilyMaxResults` | `8` | Results per search (1–20) |
| `tavil

ySearchDepth` | `basic` | `basic` / `fast` / `ultra-fast` / `advanced` |
| `tavilyIncludeAnswer` | `

true` | Ask Tavily for an LLM answer summary |
| `tavilyTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request timeout |

| `tavilyRateLimitCooldownMs` | `60000` | Cooldown after a `429` |
| `fallbackOnEmpty` | `false` |
Treat an empty result as a failure |
## Development
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Layout: `lib/index.js` (host entry) · `lib/chain.js` (the chain) · `lib/tavily.js` (Tavily node
+ ke

y ring) · `lib/routes.js` (management routes) · `lib/client.js` (browser half) ·
`lib/schema.js` (co
nfig) · `docs/开发踩坑记录.md` (pitfall log).
## Known limits
- Tavily's free tier is metered **per account**, so several keys only help when they come from diffe

rent accounts
- `advanced` depth costs twice the credits
- The seam still selects one provider id; t

his plugin *is* that one provider — the ordering is its internal logic, not a seam feature
